mir-damad.oneLineEn: Isfahan School core and Mullā Ṣadrā's teacher; time, eternity, and creation in Safavid philosophy.

miskawayh.oneLineEn: Islamic ethics systematizer who, in Refinement of Character, turned Greek virtue ethics into soul training.

montesquieu.oneLineEn: Spirit of the Laws made separation of powers and regime typology a modern political-philosophy node.

mordecai-kaplan.oneLineEn: Founder of Reconstructionist Judaism who read Judaism as an evolving religious civilization.

moses-de-leon.oneLineEn: Key figure in Zohar transmission and authorship; medieval Kabbalah lineage node.

moses-mendelssohn.oneLineEn: Haskalah hub; Jerusalem treats religious power, tolerance, and Jewish civic status.

motoori-norinaga.oneLineEn: Japanese kokugaku figure remaking aesthetics and identity around classics and mono no aware.

muhammad-abduh.oneLineEn: Egyptian modernist reformer coordinating Islam and modern society via education, law, and rational exegesis.

nachmanides.oneLineEn: Ramban joined exegesis, halakhah, and early Kabbalah in the Maimonidean controversies.

nasir-al-din-tusi.oneLineEn: Philosopher, ethicist, and astronomer linking post-Avicennan philosophy, Shīʿī theology, and math astronomy.

nasir-khusraw.oneLineEn: Ismāʿīlī poet-thinker whose Persian philosophical verse treats cosmology, revelation, and soul's return.

nelson-goodman.oneLineEn: Constructivist epistemology, symbol systems, and aesthetics; fills Quine's neighborhood.

nichiren.oneLineEn: Founder of Nichiren Buddhism via Lotus faith and national-protection discourse in Japan.

nicolai-hartmann.oneLineEn: New ontology; fills German lines between phenomenology and metaphysics.

octavio-paz.oneLineEn: Mexican poet-thinker who, in Labyrinth of Solitude, analyzed Mexican identity, solitude, and modernity.

ogyu-sorai.oneLineEn: Edo Confucian who criticized Zhu Xi learning via ancient rhetoric and ritual-music institutions.

patanjali.oneLineEn: Traditional author of the Yoga Sūtras; identity-tier anchor of eight-limbed yoga practice theory.

paul-natorp.oneLineEn: Marburg neo-Kantian core after Cohen on epistemology and social pedagogy.

pei-wei.oneLineEn: Western Jin thinker who, in On Esteeming Being, reflected on xuanxue's valuing of non-being.

pf-strawson.oneLineEn: Descriptive metaphysics and ordinary-language tradition; Kant-analytic interface.
